newsitem.title: USA: Bemis to sell packaging machinery business.
newsitem.headline: Bemis to sell packaging machinery business.

text.p: Bemis Co Inc said it reached an agreement in principle to sell its packaging businesses to privately held Barry-Wehmiller Group Inc for undisclosed terms.
The businesses include Accraply Inc, Bemis Packaging Machinery Co and Hayssen Manufacturing Co. These three businesses had combined net sales in 1996 of about $93 million.
Barry-Wehmiller, a packaging automation company, will have revenues of $250 million following the acquisition.
Bemis manufactures flexible packaging and pressure-sensitive materials, with sales of $1.7 billion.
